internal_link_alignment.description: Analyzes internal links pointing to non-canonical URLs
internal_link_alignment.impact: Identifies wasted authority from misaligned internal links

soft_duplicate_detection.description: Detects content duplicates using title+H1 fingerprinting

cross_cluster_conflicts.description: Detects multiple clusters pointing to same canonical
cross_cluster_conflicts.impact: Catches pagination, language, and parameter canonical bugs

search_console_alignment.description: Compare declared vs calculated vs Google-chosen canonical

significant_parameters.description: Content-significant parameters are preserved in variant keys

external_canonical_detection.description: Detects and flags canonicals pointing to external domains
external_canonical_detection.impact: Identifies syndicated content or misconfigured canonicals

redirect_chain_integration.description: Redirect chains are not currently integrated
redirect_chain_integration.impact: Future enhancement for complete URL consolidation analysis

non_crawled_variants.description: Cannot detect URL variants that are not internally linked or declared as canonical
non_crawled_variants.requires: Server log files or Google Search Console data
non_crawled_variants.impact: May miss externally-linked variants or orphaned pages

canonical_intent_confidence.description: Intent confidence is heuristic based on crawl data only
canonical_intent_confidence.requires: Google indexation data, impressions, and ranking signals for perfect accuracy
